conviction_note: Baseline median reaction is 9.93% and the last print delivered +47.4%, so the bar is high; I take a moderate negative because an 8-K carrying a management change with a press release was filed on 2026-08-20 in the middle of a 19% seven-session collapse and is referenced nowhere in the 83-item capture, and because the stock enters the print 269% above its 52-week low after that reaction.

findings.finding: An 8-K with items 5.02 and 9.01 - a director or officer change announced with a press release - was filed on 2026-08-20, inside the window in which the stock fell from $102 to $83 in seven business days, and it is mentioned in none of the 83 captured items; the admissible social stream on 2026-08-18 records only '102 to 83 in 7 business days, wow. No bounce' with no cause given.

findings.why_not_priced: No news search was run for this ticker (n_queries=0 in every admissible sweep) and the entire captured social stream is retail banter about the brand - not one message references a management change. A 19% drawdown with 'no bounce' and no stated cause, straddling a 5.02 filing, is a joined-up fact that no aggregator publishes. Direction is uncertain without the body, and I lean negative because departures get filed before results and because the successor's first commentary usually resets the guide.
findings.independence: A SCHEDULE 13D/A was filed on 2026-07-29 with a Form 4 the same day, a separate filing series showing a >5% holder repositioning three weeks before the 5.02 - https://www.sec.gov/cgi-bin/browse-edgar?action=getcompany&CIK=0001856437&type=SC+13D

findings.finding: Positioning into the print is extended and the sell-side is behind it: the stock is 269% above its 52-week low after a +47.44% reaction to the previous print, UBS's raised target of $95 (from $90, 2026-08-18) is only 12% above the pre-print price, another corpus item puts the 'latest analyst PT' at $80 - below the market - and participants describe high short interest and a squeeze dynamic rather than a fundamental bid.
findings.why_not_priced: Individually all wire copy; the combination is not, and it describes an equity trading above the sell-side's own marks on short-covering flow rather than on estimate revisions. A print that merely meets expectations removes the squeeze fuel. It cuts against itself to the extent a genuine short base can be squeezed further, which is why the band is wide.
